newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Q1 forex derivatives trading up 15.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Q1 forex derivatives trading up 15.2 pct.

text.p: South Korea's foreign exchange derivatives trading volume rose 15.2 percent to $110.4 billion in the first quarter from $95.8 billion in the fourth quarter of last year, the Bank of Korea said on Wednesday.

A bank statement said corporations and financial institutions turned to derivatives to hedge their risks due to instability in major foreign currencies and global interest rates. They were also eager to avoid losses resulting from a steep rise of the dollar against the won.
The bank said trading volume of forward foreign exchange contracts gained 10.1 percent to $74.9 billion in the first quarter from $68.0 billion in the previous quarter.
Financial futures trading rose 27.7 percent to $35.5 billion in the first quarter against $27.8 billion in the previous quarter.
